package.name: gpu_planning_ros2
package.description: ROS 2 adapter for the gpu_planning substrate-consistent planner zoo. Exposes the six GPU planners (pRRTC, MIT*, MHA*, wPA*SE, STOMP, CHOMP) behind a ROS 2-native plan service (gpu_planning_msgs/PlanJointPath) and ingests collision geometry from gpu_planning_msgs/CollisionScene. Built on common_interfaces only — no MoveIt dependency. Non-box collision primitives are conservatively over-approximated to enclosing oriented bounding boxes, matching the substrate's OBB collision path.
